svg.title: CoGenRec framework
svg.desc: Dual-pathway CVS measurements, complementarity-driven generative reconstruction, exposure-aware endpoint encoding, and bidirectional recurrent temporal propagation.

svg.title: COP and AOP measurement timing
svg.desc: RGB0 and RGB1 exposure windows are centered at t0 and t25. Each exposure contains two valid TD intervals and one SD midpoint sample. Inter-exposure SD samples align with sampling instants; TD images span adjacent instants. All TD and SD images are horizontally mirrored. Middle times are omitted for readability. A moving scan extends through the RGB, intra-exposure and inter-exposure rows.

svg.title: CoGenRec reconstruction pipeline
svg.desc: The two exposure-aware endpoint encoders and between-exposure TD/SD feed the bidirectional recurrent temporal propagator. Multi-scale features guide ControlNet and detail fusion. Stable Diffusion and the VAE decoder reconstruct RGB video.

svg.title: Exposure-Aware Endpoint Encoder
svg.desc: TD, RGB and SD inputs each carry the 0/1 endpoint subscript. Three aligned hierarchical branches encode each endpoint. At every encoded scale, TD enters the named Cross-Attention Fusion region from above and SD from below, conditioning the RGB hierarchy inside. The native RGB feature and the three fused encoded RGB features feed F_end,0/1 through a separate output lane below the RGB blocks. The Four Scales caption and stacked feature glyph are omitted.

svg.title: Bi-Directional Recurrent Temporal Propagator
svg.desc: The upper stream propagates left to right from the first endpoint using TD_t and SD_t. The lower stream propagates right to left from the second endpoint using TD_(t+1) and SD_t. The streams are horizontally staggered so their post-update hidden states enter each shared central control volume V_ctrl^t through straight vertical arrows. Event inputs sit above the forward stream and below the backward stream.
